analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services held its H2 FY26 and FY26 results conference call to discuss its operational and financial performance, fleet expansion, and market outlook. Management reported robust growth in total income, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by owned fleet expansion and disciplined cost management. The company discussed ongoing vessel deployments, dry docking schedules, contract rates, and strategic initiatives to capitalize on increasing offshore demand. Additionally, management provided a conservative top-line growth guidance of 10% for the current financial year while maintaining a positive long-term outlook. ABS Marine Services Limited released its investor presentation for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in consolidated total income to ₹322.64 Cr and net profit to ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for the current financial year assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margin to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about opportunities in the offshore and maritime sectors driven by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and support packages for shipbuilding.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC is expected to release a tender for about 20 vessels anytime soon.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company scheduled delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost of acquisition for both new vessels, Hades and the MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for H2 FY26 stood at INR183.11 crores, growing by 78.93% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for H2 FY26 surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for H2 FY26 increased by 158.22% to INR49.46 crores, and PAT margin improved by 829 basis points to 27.01%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 158.22% to INR49.46 crores, with PAT margin improving by 829 basis points to 27.01%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a signed five-year contract with Hardy Oil for the vessel Hades.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already got a charter with Hardy Oil for a five-year contract and...

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a fixed three-year contract with Schlumberger (SLB) for AM Passion at $16,000 per day.
orders_capacity.quote: And then as of now, we are getting about $16,000 per day and that is fixed for three years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that premium increases on vessel acquisitions are primarily driven by exchange rate fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a vision to expand and add seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated confidence in sustaining growth momentum and delivering long-term value.
management_commitments.quote: With a healthy order book, efficient fleet utilization, and clear focus on technology, sustainability, and disciplined execution, we are confident of sustaining our growth momentum and delivering long-term value.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
